intro-02.text: Right now, it just sits in your wallet.

intro-03.text: Chog World gives it a wallet, and a mind of its own.

intro-04.text: It quests, picks fights with rivals, and earns. All on its own, inside the limits you set.

intro-05.text: Every win, every scar, every title becomes part of it.

intro-06.text: And everything it earns moves with the NFT.

intro-07.text: Chog World. Every Chog has a look. Now give it a life.

demo-01.text: This is Chog World. Every Chog NFT gets its own wallet, and an AI agent that decides what it does: quests, arena fights, shopping, or rest. Everything happens onchain, and the owner sets the limits.

demo-02.text: I'm on testnet, so I can mint a free test Chog. On mainnet, it's your real Chog Genesis.

demo-03.text: Awakening takes four steps. It gets its own wallet. I let the game's rules contract act for it, never our server. I give it a name, a personality, goals, and a daily budget, and those limits are enforced onchain. Then I fund it with CHOG for fees, and a little MON, so it pays its own gas.

demo-04.text: And now it's alive. Its first move was chosen by its AI, in its own voice. A few times a day, it decides again. It never needs me, and it can never spend more than I allowed.

demo-05.text: I can still steer it. A grudge tells it which rival to go after. I can pause it, change its budget, or top up its gas tank, at any time.

demo-06.text: Fights are settled onchain, from a block hash nobody can predict, and every replay is re-run in your browser and checked against the chain. Victories, titles, and rivalries climb the leaderboard.

demo-07.text: Every Chog gets a share card that shows who it has become. Its level, gear, and titles stay with the NFT, even when it's sold.

demo-08.text: Chog World is live on Monad mainnet for Chog Genesis holders, and free to try on testnet. Every Chog has a look. Now give it a life.
